title: Only One Rook Comes Back
setup: Black's rook guards the back rank from a8 and your rooks are doubled on the d-file with the queen watching from g1.
hint: Count how many of your pieces can reach the eighth rank, then count how many of Black's can answer.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} offers a rook the defender must take, and {{Rxd8}} pulls it off a8. The second rook follows with {{Rxd8#}}. One defender cannot answer two attackers on the same square; the count is the whole tactic.
